interpretation: Source-turn predictability, not unique psychologically correct action. Outside-square-brackets is a native-format proxy for visible words/actions, not a semantic visibility certificate. T has released before-states; R/S recur. World and released motivation are shared and can provide parallel information. Equal book macro with equal trajectories inside each book; n=8 convenience books, descriptive intervals. Compare conditions within each consumer; absolute NLL is not a cross-model ability ranking.
